title: Mind the Gap: Aligning the Brain with Language Models Requires a Nonlinear and Multimodal Approach
summaryPoints: Critiques the traditional linear regression assumption between LLM activations and fMRI responses.
Shows that nonlinear multimodal mappings recover brain-language correspondence that linear encodings underestimate.
Connects predictive-processing views of cortex with autoregressive Transformer internal states.
significance: Re-evaluates the mathematical foundation of how artificial neural representations correspond to biological neural activity.
labRelevance: Connectome Lab preprint; theoretical grounding for the Neuro-X Large Brain Model initiative.
